aiVerification.summary: Draft cites existing rows but incorrectly mixes material bending checks, function groups, and header-derived measurements into one unclear comparison.
issues: Changed factor combines unrelated labels and an invalid baseline/test structure.
Material bending and function results need clearer row-level grouping.
Header row Test!33 is treated as measurement data.
Condition '2 | date' appears parsed from row metadata, not a real condition.
Decision text supports rates but not the current combined comparison wording.
correctionPlan: Define primary factor as frame condition/status, not 'Normal vs Frame, 2'.
Separate material bending-rate outcome from function NG-rate outcome under the same report context if justified.
Remove measurement outcome derived only from header row Test!33.
Correct row 17 and row 19 condition labels using their actual table columns.
Use decision row to summarize observed rates without adding unsupported judgement.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist, but some are insufficient because header and misparsed rows are used as evidence.
